title: i18n: ru / ar count agreement outside the plural families — code-selected `*Plural` pairs and single-form count keys render the wrong noun form (objectui#11432's remaining positions)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect family, class (a), the rest of objectui#11432's class. objectui#11432 (PR objectui#11443) gives every i18next count plural family every CLDR category its language selects, and pins that with a test computed from `Intl.PluralRules`. Two other spellings of the same defect fall outside that family rule, because their selection is not i18next's.

`reach:` named producers, measured by the objectui#11432 dev with plain i18next 26.4.0 over the shipped packs at PR objectui#11443's head `7e18d1f6b` (dev report `5945799531`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]` and `[1]`). Reader who acts: triage first (grade and route; the selection sites sit outside `packages/i18n`), then the `domain:ui` seat. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Spelling 1: code-selected `*Plural` pairs (the component picks the key)
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/CommentAttachment.tsx` selects `detail.attachmentCountPlural` when `attachments.length !== 1`.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/ThreadedReplies.tsx` selects `detail.replyCountPlural` when `replies.length !== 1`.
- Measured: `ru` 3 reads "3 вложений" and 21 reads "21 ответов"; `ar` 2 reads "2 مرفقات", 11 reads "11 ردود", 100 reads "100 مرفقات". A two-way `=== 1` switch cannot express `ru`'s few/many or `ar`'s six categories.

## Spelling 2: single-form count keys (no family at all)
- `apps/console` `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` `bulkApproveTitle` (`count = actionableSelectedRows.length`);
- `plugin-grid` `ImportWizard.tsx` `grid.import.importNRows` (`rows.length`);
- `components` `data-table.tsx` `table.modified` (`pendingChanges.size`);
- `app-shell` `HomeRail.tsx` / `InboxPopover.tsx` `notifications.approvalsPending`.
- Measured with `ru` at count 3: "Согласовать 3 запросов?", "Импортировать 3 строк", "3 строк изменено", "3 ожидающих утверждений". Some `en` values are single-form too ("N row modified").
- The dev's census of `ru` values outside any family, where the count placeholder is followed by a Cyrillic word, has many false positives (abbreviations, labels, "из N"). **The defective set needs a per-key read**; this list is the measured sample, not the population.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)
- Both spellings become i18next count families. The `*Plural` pair becomes one family, its component calls `t(key, { count })`, and the `=== 1` switch goes. A single-form count key becomes a family in `en` and in every pack. Then PR objectui#11443's computed pin covers them by construction, so no second enumeration is needed.
- The enumeration to produce first: every `t(…, { count })` call site, every `*Plural` / `*One` sibling pair, and every pack value interpolating `{{count}}` outside a family. Each is either converted, or recorded as count-neutral (a label such as "Noun: N").

## Dedupe
The 808 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (back to #3162, REST, grepped locally 2026-10-02):
- `attachmentCountPlural` / `replyCountPlural` 1;
- `bulkApproveTitle` / `importNRows` / `approvalsPending` 1;
- "ru … count … agreement" 1.

All three hits are PR objectui#11443 itself, the source. `table.modified` 0; code-selected plural 0. Control: `plural` 8 (objectui#11432, objectui#11415 and their PRs among them).
